front_lawn.description: You stand on the overgrown front lawn of an old white house. A battered mailbox leans by the path. Jerry, the village blacksmith, is hammering at a portable anvil by the gate, and Joe watches nervously from the window of his little shop across the lane.

objects.name: mailbox
objects.description: A dented tin mailbox on a wooden post.

objects.name: leaflet
objects.text: WELCOME TO ZOAIRK! Everything you do here is remembered.

npcs.name: Jerry
npcs.profile: Jerry, a grumpy, proud village blacksmith. Short-tempered, protective of his tools, secretly kind. Speaks bluntly.

npcs.name: Joe
npcs.profile: Joe, a nervous shopkeeper who watches everything from his shop window. Easily startled, polite, worried about fire and damage.

house.description: A dusty front hall. A guard dozes on a chair by a stack of old books, beside a marble statue and an iron-banded chest.

objects.name: book
objects.text: The pages describe a lighthouse far to the east.

objects.name: statue
objects.description: A life-size marble statue of a stern old knight.

objects.name: chest
objects.description: An iron-banded wooden chest at the foot of the stairs.

contents.name: coin
contents.description: A heavy gold coin stamped with a lighthouse.

npcs.name: Theo
npcs.profile: Theo, a sleepy house guard. Slow to wake, gruff when disturbed, loyal to the owner of the house.
npcs.title: the guard
